title: Beyond Prompt Brittleness: Evaluating the Reliability and Consistency of Political Worldviews in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with statements from Voting Advice Applications (VAAs) across multiple European countries and analyzing their responses for alignment with left, right, or center political parties. The methodology includes evaluating the reliability of these stances by testing model responses against semantic paraphrases, negations, label-order inversions, and sampling variations before calculating policy issue consistency.
